description: Reconstruct one EAST equilibrium (65x65, Rust inverse) from a measurement document, the EAST MDSplus trees, or an in-memory measurement set; plus plotting, the capability catalog and the artifact manifests.

args.help: measurement document: IMAS-shaped JSON/YAML or a JSON-LD normal form (needs --time)
GUI_v5 est2 path: read 79 probes straight from the 'east' MDSplus tree (self-contained, no fydata); implies --preset gui_v5
MDSplus server host; default is the device deck's declared server
shot number (with --time: the data source; with --input: stamped on the result)
time [s]
directory for the g-file (default: a fresh run directory under $FYLITE_RUN_DIR, never the working directory)

(--east only) add the 11-chord POINT polarimeter-interferometer: line-integrated n_e + Faraday-rotation internal current constraint (POINT-constrained / 'kinetic' reconstruction). signel/sigpol default to placeholders — set real calibration via --point-sig
uniform POINT error bars (density, Faraday); override the placeholder defaults
POINT time-average half-window [ms] (default 30 ms, from the GUI_v5 .fig)
POINT fringe-jump gate: drop a chord whose |line-integrated n_e| falls below FRAC x median (default 0.15; <=0 disables)
(--east only) add the Thomson+TXCS kprfit=1 direct-pressure constraint (Li-2013 rung); stack on --point
fractional pressure error bar sigpre_frac (default 0.2)
Thomson Te outlier ceiling [eV] (default 8000)
(--east --point only) pin the density spline with Thomson local n_e points (R_NE_TS rows) — strengthens the Faraday forward model
drop the magnetic probes from the fit (flux-loop-only): the quality baseline while per-channel probe calibration is missing
render the flux map after the run (default <gfile>.png)
print the run summary as JSON

commands.name: plot
commands.help: render a GEQDSK flux map to PNG/JPG

args.help: output image (default <gfile>.png)

commands.name: describe
commands.help: print the machine-readable capability catalog (JSON-LD): the first-batch artifact manifest set — efit/neo/tglf compute artifacts, the kinetic-reconstruction workflow, and the EAST MDSplus data artifact

args.help: human-readable listing instead of JSON-LD

commands.name: cases
commands.help: list / show / check / RUN the two corpora: the scenario corpus (cases/: fyo/spo ScenarioSpecification documents + catalogue) and, with --benchmark, the public V&V register (benchmark/: fyo:ComparisonRecord documents rendered from the kernel repository) — the CLI is the primary debugging environment; --run maps a case's parameter settings onto the corresponding Python entry (S-2) and records the run, or runs a record's private gates in $FYLITE_KERNEL; --report renders a case (or a recorded run, --from) into MyST + SVG through a presentation spec

args.help: a case id from the catalogue (or, with --benchmark, a record id such as V-01): print that document
corpus directory (default: ./cases, then the checkout's cases/; with --benchmark ./benchmark) — repo data, does NOT ship with the wheel
address the public V&V register (benchmark/) instead of the scenario corpus: list records, print one, --check its structure, --plan / --run its gates
structural check: every catalogue entry's document exists and parses, no orphan files, at most one initial case per bar; non-zero exit on failure
machine-readable output
print the case -> entry mapping and the full field accounting (mapped / sub-capability / shared / ui), without running
map the named case onto its Python entry and run it through the tool face — leaves manifest / acceptance / ledger; bars with no faithful mapping are refused by name
(zerod cases) engage tier B: solve the energy balance with the case's confinement-scaling knobs instead of only evaluating the prescription
(--benchmark --run) the kernel checkout whose private gates to run (default: $FYLITE_KERNEL); refused by name when absent

render the named case as a REPORT: run it through the data layer's JSON door (one fyo plan in, one spo record out) and write MyST markdown + SVG figures + the presentation spec it was drawn by (FYL-REPORT-06 §13); with --from, render an existing record instead of running
(--report) a record.jsonld or a `fylite-case run` directory to render instead of running the case
(--report) output directory (default: $FYLITE_RUN_DIR or ./records, under the record id; with --from, beside the record)
(--report) a spo:PresentationSpecification document to draw by, instead of the one derived by rule
(--report) language of captions and prose: zh (default) or en

commands.name: manifest
commands.help: check, re-seal, or export the authored JSON-LD artifact manifests (python/fylite/_manifest/*.jsonld — files are the source; the engine only loads/validates/seals them)

args.help: recompute derived hash fields (semantic_signature/storage_hash) in place
export the manifest set + derived catalog to DIR

commands.name: replay
commands.help: re-run a recorded session from its ledger: resolve each node by its artifact_ref, feed handles along the edges, and compare the artefacts with the ones recorded

args.help: path to a session's ledger.jsonld (workflow-ir instance)
name for the replay's own session directory (default replay-<original>)
replay even where the published artifact version has moved since the run; the report says which nodes drifted
print the replay report as JSON

commands.name: report
commands.help: render one recorded run as a MyST report (unified academic template: 摘要/方法/结果/验收/复现性; array summaries and figures, never bulk arrays) — default lands report.md in the run directory

args.help: run id (searched under $FYLITE_RUN_DIR) or path to a run directory
output file or directory (default: <run>/report.md; figures land beside it)
skip figure rendering; the report says so instead of thinning silently
print the report instead of writing a file (no figures are rendered)

commands.name: whence
commands.help: say which run produced a file and where that run came from — the lookup is BY CONTENT (the file is hashed against the sha256 every run manifest records), so a copied or renamed artefact still resolves and a modified one honestly does not

args.help: one or more files to trace back
run root to search (default $FYLITE_RUN_DIR / the cache)
the full record instead of the one-line lineage

commands.name: alias
commands.help: give a run a readable name (`name@vN`) or list the register — the name is BESIDE the run id, never instead of it: handles, ledger edges and manifests keep holding ids

args.help: the run id to name (omit with --list)
the readable name; the version is the register's to assign
print the register instead of adding to it
run root (default $FYLITE_RUN_DIR)

commands.name: serve
commands.help: serve the capability catalog + entry invocation as JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio (experimental; one message per line, EOF to stop)

commands.name: mcp
commands.help: serve fylite as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) stdio server: curated tools (describe/run/inspect/plot) + tools reflected from the artifact manifests; results are shaped summaries
